source_datasets.name: Sport Facilities
source_datasets.source_vintage: Based on the 2024 Sports Facilities National Census; page last updated 2026-03-12
source_datasets.license: Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0; allows copy, modify and commercial/non-commercial use with conspicuous attribution; see official license
source_datasets.required_attribution: Contains information from Sport Facilities accessed on 2026-10-18 from data.gov.sg, made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0.
source_datasets.coordinate_semantics: Sport facility venue coordinates are supplied to only three decimal degrees, approximately 100 m resolution; they represent facility/venue points, not food outlet units.

matching_method: Compare only current blank-coordinate workbook rows with exact six-digit postal code and exact normalized SportSG VenueName substring in Full Address. Duplicate SportSG sport-type rows are collapsed on venue/postal/coordinate. No postcode-only record is proposed.
limitations: The source contains no street number or street fields, so the exact venue name in the target address is used together with exact postal code.
Coordinates are rounded to three decimal places and are not precise enough to claim outlet or storefront positioning.
No Mapbox Search Box calls/results were used.
No Mapbox token or OneMap token was read or used.
